item.title: D2 GIRLS WRESTLING: Schaffer, Kivler score big wins on Day 1
item.description: PLAINS TWP. — If anyone could understand what Cidney Schaffer was going through, it was the girl right behind her scorer’s table. As the Lackawanna Trail freshman prepared to take the mat in her first District 2 Girls Wrestling Championship on Friday night, pacing and going through her pre-match motions was Nanticoke Area sophomore Emily Kivler. item.title: D2 BOYS WRESTLING: Berwick’s Ramos secures upset to reach semis on Day 1
item.description: PLAINS TWP. — Berwick’s Jamir Ramos knew it was a tall task for a No. 7 seed to make it to the District 2 Class 2A boys wrestling semifinals, especially when the Bulldogs senior lost to his quarterfinal opponent by first-period pin during the regular season. Ramos had his doubts before the match, but when the time came he believed in himself.
